title: Agent development runtime
description: Namespaced lifecycle gates with revision CAS, native Graphify context and a single scoped review fingerprint.

fragment.inline: Read the source map, create WorkCheckpoint/v2 with source revision and one next action; derived GSD state remains under .planning/agent-flow/workstreams/<work-id>. If native Graphify is fresh, query it for impact context; absent or stale graph falls back to current sources. Record one immutable PlatformKnowledgeContext/v1 from official Academy sources, local snapshots and the applicable domain skills before implementation; cache immutable hashes and pass only its compact digest. Resolve one PonytailPolicyDecision/v1 for implementation-planner with mode lite; keep both policy and knowledge context out of requirements decisions. Before using the parent session as a researcher, resolve one AgentRoutingDecision/v1 from the repository role registry; use a Luna specialist for bounded research when no valid same-scope agent exists.

Validate plan:post: source plan, acceptance, allowed paths, explicit B/S/AC/component/file coordination keys and test plan are complete. Use native GSD Core 1.11 plan-drift checks for undeclared same-wave coupling and cross-artifact fact drift; resolve any per-plan agent_hint through native GSD routing once, without a custom model mapper; route a finding back to the plan before execute. The shared-worktree ownership ledger is local runtime state, not a product authority.

Validate execute:pre before a tracked mutation; checkpoint revision, source revision, leases/imports and the current FIFO ownership claim must be current. A queued file owner blocks mutation. Require the current cycle's PlatformKnowledgeContext/v1 and compact applicable skills/docs binding; a stale or missing context is a typed GAP. If the frozen plan has agent_hint, let native OpenGSD resolve it once for this code-producing lane; do not use that route for reviewers, security, architect or delivery. For accepted delivery/testing feedback, follow the typed next action through CorrectionAuthorization/v1 before beginCorrection; do not require review triage for a bounded local feedback correction. Resolve AgentRoutingDecision/v1 before a code-producing dispatch: reuse only a current same-scope agent, otherwise use the configured specialist; blind or independent roles must receive a fresh isolated route. Bind one trusted PonytailPolicyDecision/v1 with mode full to the code-producing dispatch; absent or degraded Ponytail capability blocks mutation.

Seal execute:post atomically: calculate the one scoped implementation fingerprint and clear prior reviews, verification, delivery and runtime receipts. Reuse the shared RuntimeAssuranceContext/v1 identity for compact status and dispatch evidence; do not reread immutable scope. If native GSD Core 1.11 reports a complexity/CRAP trigger, consume its one scoped proposal and route at most one bounded root-cause refactor through the existing remediation protocol; a repeated proposal becomes a typed GAP, never an open-ended self-review loop or assurance bypass. After two failed review generations, stop before another review packet and reserve one fresh history-isolated gpt-5.6-sol/high blind architect at assurance stage 4 with BR/SR/AC plus external observation pointers only.

Validate verify:pre: first record DocumentationSkillValidation/v1 against the immutable knowledge context, then reuse the one immutable RuntimeAssuranceContext/v1 and emit only RuntimeStatusDelta/v1 for status-only changes. If a pre-fix runtime cleared the context during seal, use typed restorePlatformKnowledgeContext from exact compact history; never edit the checkpoint or create a fallback file. The validator is separate from and not counted as the exact-three review set. The repeating-cycle ArchitectureDiagnosis/v1 is diagnostic, never a review receipt. If its assigned architect fails isolation/profile/context, record ArchitectDispatchDisqualification/v1 and reserve one new unique handle; never reuse or hand-edit the dispatch. Exactly three clean fresh isolated ReviewReceipt/v2 records must still match the current packet ID/version and fingerprint. Bind Ponytail mode off for correctness/security/verifier/architect prompts; no Ponytail context may enter blind assurance.

Validate verify:post reverse validation and evidence truthfulness; Static evidence never closes Runtime. Use native GSD Core 1.11 scope/diff and goal-backward consistency checks when available; an out-of-scope committed diff is a typed finding, not an automatic scope expansion. Query native verification.status once for the current phase and pass only status/next_action/pointers forward. Include native Graphify topology diff as supporting architecture-impact evidence when available.

Validate ship:pre: reuse the current native verification.status result when its phase, source and revision are current; do not rerun a full GSD verify only to rediscover the same status. Clean reviews, reverse validation, DeliveryReceipt/v2 and an explicit RuntimeReceipt/v2 disposition are still required.

Validate ship:post: development/runtime status stays separate and push remains an explicit user command. Route only the typed runtime next_action through native GSD transition/auto-chain facilities; never auto-approve human, review, Runtime or delivery authority.
